Widget Industry Trends 2022

The widget industry in 2022 saw significant consolidation with 3 major mergers among top-50 suppliers. According to the Widget Council, global production reached 800 million units, a 12% increase over 2021.

Supply chain disruptions caused by the 2021 shipping crisis continued into Q1 2022, with lead times averaging 14 weeks for specialty components. Companies that diversified suppliers reduced delays by 40%.
